name: user-tools
description: A User Tools panel: pick the model and the effort with a click, switch the narrator, Remote Control and Prompt Upgrade. Its name, models and efforts are yours to change in /config.

title.title: Panel name
title.description: The name on the footer button and the pane's tab.

models.title: Models
models.description: The model buttons, comma separated, each Label=model (an alias such as opus or a full id).

efforts.title: Efforts
efforts.description: The effort buttons, comma separated, each Label=level or just the level (low, medium, high, xhigh, max).

upgradeModel.title: Prompt Upgrade model
upgradeModel.description: The model that asks the questions and rewrites the prompt: an alias (sonnet, haiku) or a full id.
